summary: Iteration 5 — verified all 3 new features on Pritha Cabinet CRM (duplicate-phone handoff, team overview stats, per-user daily goals). Backend: 25/25 pytest passes in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py — covers (a) GET /customers/lookup?phone auth-required/400-invalid/exists-false/is_mine true+false; (b) GET /admin/team-stats 401/403/admin-shape (all 13 required keys + 7 rows + default_goal); (c) PATCH /admin/users daily_goal boundary (0→400, 1001→400), combined with display_name, reflects in /admin/users listing, /admin/team-stats and /stats/leaderboard 'goal' column; (d) /stats/today.goal follows per-user custom or falls back to settings default; (e) /stats/leaderboard per-row pct == min(1, total/user_goal). Regressions green: admin/emp7 login, customers list, admin users list (8 total), PATCH display_name persists, empty PATCH→400. Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) /team page — summary card shows 4 pills (Calls today / Sales / Revenue ₹ / On duty N/7), all 7 employee rows render with avatar, colored ABSENT/On duty/Checked out pill, '@username · N customers', 3-metric row (calls/goal, sales, ₹revenue), progress bar, caption '% of daily goal · custom goal' only when custom — verified emp3 with custom goal 53 shows the ' · custom goal' suffix while emp1 does not. (2) Team edit modal — 'Daily call goal' text field with placeholder 'Default: 50' visible; setting emp4 to 77 and saving fires PATCH, closes modal, and the row instantly re-renders to '0 / 77 CALLS' + '0% of daily goal · custom goal'; reopening pre-fills with 77; setting 2000 shows the validation error banner. (3) PunchSaleModal duplicate handoff — seeded a customer 'DupTest UI' (+91 9998887777) for emp7, opened Punch from /sales, switched to New customer, entered a different name with the same phone + amount 500 and submitted → sale was NOT created; yellow banner appeared 'Already in our list · DupTest UI · assigned to you' with an amber 'Use' pill; tapping Use flipped mode to Existing with 'DupTest UI' preselected in the picker button; second submit created the sale and it appears in the sales list ('DupTest UI · ₹500'), confirming it linked to the existing customer id. No red screens, no navigation crashes, no blocking issues.
action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: iteration test suite currently has no explicit 'clear daily_goal' API — PATCH cannot unset once set. Consider allowing daily_goal:null in AdminUserUpdate to $unset the field, so admin can revert to the workspace default without a direct DB edit.

Optional UX: the emp4 edit-modal daily-goal input value stays populated with '77' on re-open. If admin wants to fall back to default, they must know that leaving the field blank on a subsequent save is a no-op (no clear). Consider a small 'Reset to default (50)' link next to the field.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::lookup_customer (L612-624) — returns is_mine flag from the current user's viewpoint; uses phone_norm index so lookup is O(log n). Good.

server.py::admin_team_stats (L525-599) — 4 aggregations executed serially with `to_list(200)` caps; fine for 7 employees today but for larger tenants the customers aggregation ($group by assigned_to) will scale linearly with total customers. Not a blocker.
server.py::admin_update_user (L514-517) — boundary 1..1000 is inclusive; matches spec. Note: daily_goal cannot be cleared via PATCH (no None-sentinel handling).
server.py::stats_today (L890) — cleanly reads `u.get('daily_goal')` (falsy→default). Since 0 is invalid via the setter, no risk of 0 overriding default. Good.

PunchSaleModal.tsx (L80-105) — on 409, calls api.lookupCustomer to fetch the existing customer for the banner; handles lookup failure with a graceful fallback message. Correct control flow — no sale is punched until the user retries via Existing mode.

team.tsx::EditEmployeeModal (L270-284) — only pushes daily_goal in the patch when the value actually changed OR the user was on the default before; empty string is treated as no-op (matches spec 'empty value doesn't set daily_goal'). Good.
